facts.fact: The Minister of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation presented to the parliamentary budget committee a 2026 budget of 27,238,035,553 FCFA for her ministry (9,774,411,267 operating, 17,463,624,286 capital).
facts.system: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation budget 2026

facts.fact: Programme Numérique is allocated 12,372,151,413 FCFA in the proposed 2026 budget, with four flagship projects: broadband phase 2, digital uses and trust, Smart Gouv phase 2, and digital transformation of local authorities.
The ministry's 2026 credits of 27,238,035,553 FCFA compare with 29,033,966,192 FCFA in 2025, a fall of 6.18%, which the report attributes to a 12.22% fall in external financing.
facts.system: Ministère du Numérique et de la Digitalisation budget 2026

note: Figures are the proposed budget presented to committee; part of the ministry's money is external financing, not stated to be wholly loan-paid.
